build_generator: build a SequenceGenerator or SequenceScorer for multilingual translation inference with beam search and language-specific EOS tokens
load_dataset: load a language pair dataset split for training or validation with configurable padding and alignment options
build_dataset_for_inference: build a LanguagePairDataset for inference by appending source language ID tokens to input sequences
add_args: add task-specific CLI arguments including comma-separated language list and BOS token prepending for mBART pretraining
init_task: initialize a TranslationFromPretrainedBARTTask that registers language tokens and mask symbols in source and target dictionaries
